title: Would You Rather… (But Every Choice Is a Trap) #shorts #wouldyourather
description:
Pick one. Then read the catch. Which one could you actually survive?

#wouldyourather #thisorthat #quiz #shorts

questions.a: Hear your name whispered when you're alone
questions.b: See a stranger in every photo you take
questions.a_catch: The whisper always comes from right behind you.

questions.a: Get a phone call from yourself
questions.b_catch: It's dated next week and says: run tonight.

questions.a: Be the last person awake in town
questions.b: Be the only person who can't sleep
questions.a_catch: Everyone else is only pretending to sleep, and watching you.
questions.b_catch: The sleepers walk at night, and they hear you.

outro: A or B? Tell me which one you'd survive.
